INSERT INTO REVIEW ( REVIEW_ID, MEMBER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, CONTENT ) VALUES ( #{reviewId}, #{memberId}, #{productId}, #{content} )
mapper.select: SELECT R.REVIEW_ID, R.MEMBER_ID, R.PRODUCT_ID, R.CONTENT, R.CREATED_AT, M.NAME AS MEMBER_NAME, P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM REVIEW R JOIN MEMBER M ON R.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID JOIN PRODUCT P ON R.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE R.PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} ORDER BY R.REVIEW_ID DESC
